Card Q&A.a: It refers to when you have the specified card in the battle area or breeding area.
Card Q&A.q: What does "while you have (the specified card) on the field" mean, exactly?

Effect: While you have a [TS] trait Digimon or Tamer on the field, you can ignore this card's color requirements.
[Main] Reveal the top 3 cards of your deck. Add 1 card with the [TS] trait among them to the hand. Return the rest to the bottom of the deck. Then, place this card in the battle area.
Security Effect: [Security] Place this card in the battle area.
